name: @smartluvon/mcp

tools.name: login
tools.description: Sign in to Smartluvon via browser (OAuth) and store the tokens locally. Normally not needed — any tool triggers the browser login automatically on first use. Call it only to re-login or switch accounts.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List available Smartluvon generation models. Returns model key/id, name, description and media type. Use the key as `model` in generate_* tools.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Get a model with its parameter schema: which `options` it accepts (aspectRatio, resolution, duration, ... with allowed values and defaults) and which input files it takes. Call this before generate_* to know the valid options for a model.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a LOCAL file (image/video/audio) from disk and get a hosted URL to pass into generate_* imageUrls/videoUrls/audioUrls. Use this when the user provides a local file path. (generate_image/video also accept imagePaths directly.)

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Start an image generation (text-to-image, or image editing when imageUrls are provided). Call get_model first to see accepted options. Returns a generation id — use wait_generation to get result URLs.

model.description: Model key or id (see list_models with type=image)

mode.description: Generation mode id for multi-mode models (see get_model → modes[].id). Defaults to the first mode.

imageUrls.description: Input/reference image URLs (for editing or reference-based generation)

imagePaths.description: Local image file paths — uploaded automatically and used as inputs

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Start a video generation (text-to-video, or image-to-video when imageUrls are provided). Returns a generation id — use wait_generation to get result URLs. Video can take several minutes.

model.description: Model key or id (see list_models with type=video)

mode.description: Generation mode id for multi-mode models (see get_model → modes[].id). Defaults to the first mode.

imagePaths.description: Local image file paths — uploaded automatically and used as inputs

tools.name: generate_audio
tools.description: Start an audio generation (music or text-to-speech depending on the model). Returns a generation id — use wait_generation to get result URLs.

model.description: Model key or id (see list_models with type=audio)

mode.description: Generation mode id for multi-mode models (see get_model → modes[].id). Defaults to the first mode.

prompt.description: Text to speak (TTS) or music description

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Get the current status and result URLs of a generation by id.

tools.name: wait_generation
tools.description: Poll a generation until it completes or fails (or the timeout elapses) and return its status and result URLs.

tools.name: list_generations
tools.description: List your recent generations with optional status filter and pagination.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get your Smartluvon profile and token balance.

tools.name: calc_price
tools.description: Calculate how many tokens a generation would cost without running it.
